title: List the atom ID of the carcinogenic molecule that contains oxygen?
question: List the atom ID of the carcinogenic molecule that contains oxygen?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom_molecule AS T1
WHERE T1.element = 'o'
  AND T1.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT T2.molecule_id
    FROM atom_molecule AS T2
    WHERE T2.label = '+'
  )
